Introduction

Zhao Yue is a Chinese idol singer. She is a graduated member of Chinese idol group, SNH48 (Team NII), and an active member of its sub-unit SEN7ES (also known as 7Senses).

She was also a member of Chinese project girl group Bonbon Girls 303, formed through the Chinese survival show Produce Camp 2020, where she placed 2nd.
